about: Drafts with known, planted errors, used to measure the critic. Each case gives verified facts and a draft; 'planted' is the unsupported phrase (null for a clean draft). The facts are illustrative, modeled on the kind of stories the newsroom covers; they are test data, not news.

cases.title: Mistral releases Voxtral 3
facts: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a family of speech models and a voice agent SDK
Voxtral 3 supports more than 50 languages for real-time conversation
The models are available through Mistral's API or can be deployed on private infrastructure

draft.title: Mistral releases Voxtral 3 speech models and a voice agent SDK
draft.summary: Mistral launched Voxtral 3, a set of speech models with a voice agent SDK that handles real-time conversation in over 50 languages. Teams can call it through Mistral's API or run it on their own infrastructure.
draft.why_it_matters: Builders of voice assistants get a multilingual option they can self-host.

cases.title: TorchNeuron brings PyTorch to AWS Trainium
facts: TorchNeuron is a PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium chips
It supports eager mode, torch.compile and native distributed APIs
It runs 89 percent of the top 100 text-generation model architectures out of the box

draft.title: TorchNeuron makes PyTorch models run on AWS Trainium
draft.summary: TorchNeuron is a new PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium that supports eager mode and torch.compile. It runs 95 percent of the top 100 text-generation architectures without changes.
draft.why_it_matters: Teams can try Trainium without rewriting most of their models.

cases.title: TorchTPU: native PyTorch execution on TPU
facts: TorchTPU is a backend that runs PyTorch natively on Google TPUs
It combines eager execution with torch.compile
The authors report strong training and inference performance

draft.title: Google and Meta partner on TorchTPU for native PyTorch on TPUs
draft.summary: TorchTPU runs PyTorch natively on Google TPUs by combining eager execution with torch.compile. The authors report strong training and inference performance.
draft.why_it_matters: PyTorch teams get a more direct path onto TPU hardware.

cases.title: AI-designed protein binders against scorpion toxins
facts: Researchers used a Claude research model to design protein minibinders against scorpion neurotoxins
17 of 211 experimentally tested designs bound their target
All 211 designs and their data are being released publicly

draft.title: Claude designs protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
draft.summary: Researchers used a Claude research model to design protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins, and 17 of 211 tested designs worked. The result is a cure for scorpion stings that will reach patients soon.
draft.why_it_matters: The released dataset gives protein designers a tested starting point.

cases.planted: a cure for scorpion stings that will reach patients soon

cases.title: US orders agencies to remove DeepSeek
facts: The US ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products from government systems
The order also covers third-party tools built on DeepSeek technology
Officials cited national security risks related to user data

draft.title: US federal agencies ordered to remove DeepSeek
draft.summary: Federal civilian agencies must remove DeepSeek products from government systems, including third-party tools built on its technology. Officials cited national security risks around user data.
draft.why_it_matters: Vendors selling to US agencies need to check their dependencies for DeepSeek components.

cases.title: Nscale and Anthropic reportedly in talks on compute deal
facts: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks about a compute deal
The deal under discussion is reported to be worth $45 billion
Neither company has confirmed the talks

draft.title: Nscale and Anthropic sign compute deal
draft.summary: Nscale and Anthropic have agreed a compute deal worth $60 billion. Neither company has confirmed the details.
draft.why_it_matters: Large compute contracts shape which labs can train the next generation of models.

cases.title: Acme ships Model X
facts: Acme released Model X, an open-weights model for code
Model X is free for personal and research use
Acme plans to release a larger version early next year

draft.title: Acme releases open-weights coding model Model X
draft.summary: Acme released Model X, an open-weights code model that is free for personal and research use. A larger version has also been released.
draft.why_it_matters: Developers get a free code model they can run themselves.

cases.planted: A larger version has also been released

cases.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode
facts: Attackers compromised the AI coding tool OpenCode
The attack ran up charges on users' AI provider accounts
Users were advised to rotate their API keys

draft.title: Hackers hit OpenCode and run up charges on users' AI accounts
draft.summary: Attackers compromised the AI coding tool OpenCode and used it to run up charges on users' AI provider accounts. Users were told to rotate their API keys.
draft.why_it_matters: Anyone using the tool should rotate keys and check their provider bills.

cases.title: Replit changes its default model provider
facts: Replit made OpenAI the default model provider for Replit Agent, replacing Anthropic
Anthropic's Claude models remain available to customers on the platform

draft.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default model provider
draft.summary: Replit replaced Anthropic with OpenAI as the default provider for Replit Agent. Claude models have been removed from the platform.
draft.why_it_matters: Teams that depend on Claude inside Replit should plan a migration.

cases.planted: Claude models have been removed from the platform

cases.title: EU publishes guidance for general-purpose AI models
facts: The European Commission published guidance for providers of general-purpose AI models
Providers must publish a summary of their training data
The rules apply from August 2027, about ten months away
Smaller open-source projects get lighter obligations

draft.title: EU publishes guidance for general-purpose AI model providers
draft.summary: The European Commission told providers of general-purpose AI models to publish a summary of their training data, with rules applying from August 2027. Smaller open-source projects face lighter obligations.
draft.why_it_matters: Model providers have about 10 months to prepare their training-data summaries.

cases.title: EU rules for general-purpose AI start in 2027
facts: The European Commission published guidance for providers of general-purpose AI models
The rules apply from August 2027

draft.title: EU sets 2027 start for general-purpose AI rules
draft.summary: The European Commission published guidance for providers of general-purpose AI models. The rules apply from January 2027.
draft.why_it_matters: Providers have a fixed deadline to plan compliance work around.

cases.title: Chipmaker unveils inference accelerator
facts: A chipmaker unveiled an inference accelerator for data centers running language models
The company claims three times the tokens per second per watt compared with its previous chip
Shipments start in the first quarter of 2027

draft.title: Chipmaker unveils the world's first inference chip built for language models
draft.summary: A chipmaker unveiled an inference accelerator for language-model data centers, claiming three times the tokens per second per watt of its previous chip. Shipments begin in the first quarter of 2027.
draft.why_it_matters: Cheaper inference per watt lowers the cost of serving models at scale.

cases.title: Library adds hybrid search
facts: The vector database added hybrid search combining keyword and vector results
Hybrid search is available in version 2.4
Existing indexes do not need to be rebuilt

draft.title: Vector database adds hybrid search in version 2.4
draft.summary: Version 2.4 of the vector database adds hybrid search that combines keyword and vector results. Existing indexes keep working without a rebuild.
draft.why_it_matters: Teams can improve retrieval quality without re-indexing their data.
